يلتويان (form VIII)
# يَلْتَوِيَانِ (yaltawiyāni) /jal.ta.wi.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
# يُلْتَوَيَانِ (yultawayāni) /jul.ta.wa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
